description: PPT design skills as an installable agent plugin.

plugins.name: ppt-design-skills
plugins.description: Two agent skills for deck work. ppt-design pairs a methodology (logic, visual and structure layers) with an execution engine that generates or beautifies editable native .pptx, with 14 style presets and a five-dimension self-review. ppt-master is a tool-neutral production workflow: requirements, narrative, design system, layout rotation, data-visualisation rules, pptxgenjs and python-pptx implementation, and mandatory visual QA.
